# Byrna DualSight: A Flashlight and Laser Aiming Device for Enhanced Preparedness


When it comes to personal protection, preparation and situational awareness are essential. Having the right equipment can help users identify potential threats and navigate low-light environments with greater confidence.[The](https://byrna.com/products/byrna-dualsight?_pos=1&_psq=dual&_psid=96134c07c&_ss=e)


[Byrna DualSight](https://byrna.com/products/byrna-dualsight?_pos=1&_psq=dual&_psid=96134c07c&_ss=e)[combines a flashlight and aiming laser](https://byrna.com/products/byrna-dualsight?_pos=1&_psq=dual&_psid=96134c07c&_ss=e) into one compact accessory designed to enhance the functionality of compatible Byrna launchers.


## What Is the Byrna DualSight?


The Byrna DualSight is a combination flashlight and laser aiming device that attaches to a Byrna launcher. Designed to provide additional visibility and aiming assistance, this accessory brings two useful features together in a single, compact unit.


The DualSight features a


**300-lumen flashlight** capable of illuminating areas beyond 100 yards under suitable conditions. Whether preparing for nighttime activities or improving visibility in dimly lit environments, the integrated light provides an additional tool for assessing surroundings.


## Key Features of the Byrna DualSight


The DualSight offers several features designed to support everyday preparedness:


-


**Integrated flashlight:** A 300-lumen white light helps illuminate dark environments and improve visibility.


-


**Laser aiming assistance:** Choose between red and green laser variants to suit individual preferences and visibility conditions.


-


**Independent controls:** Buttons on either side of the device allow the flashlight and laser to operate separately or simultaneously.


-


**Strobe function:** Double-tapping the flashlight button activates a strobe mode designed to provide an additional visual deterrent.


-


**Compact design:** The integrated unit mounts directly to compatible Byrna launchers, combining two accessories in one device.


The red and green laser options provide flexibility for users seeking a laser that remains visible in various lighting conditions, including daylight.


## Enhance Your Personal Protection Setup


The Byrna DualSight offers an additional way to customize a compatible launcher for personal preparedness. By combining illumination and laser aiming assistance, it helps users better assess their surroundings and familiarize themselves with their equipment.


As with any personal protection accessory, responsible ownership includes understanding its operation, practicing safe handling, and following applicable laws.


**Explore the Byrna DualSight** to discover how this flashlight and laser combination can complement a personal protection setup and support greater preparedness when it matters most.
